verdict.rationale: Unit has a first-party API documentation page titled "Webhook Events" under its API docs, which indicates the product offers webhook event delivery. The pack contains only that page title, with no details on subscribing or receiving callbacks. Missing for 10: documented registration/subscription of webhook endpoints, the list of event types, payload format, delivery/retry and signature verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
